boundaries: A topic tag is a catalogue facet, not a legal finding that every provision belongs to that topic.
Documents, works, language versions, original fragments and assembled texts are counted separately.
No indexed rule is not the same as no tax. Only an explicitly sourced NOCHARGE rule states a modelled non-charge.
Share disposals and reorganisation are distinct from exit / migration taxation.
A limited shipping / air transport agreement is not a comprehensive income tax DTA.
Whole-statute collection can incidentally include personal tax provisions without enabling personal tax calculations.
The corpus keeps current / retained text rather than a complete historical statute archive; an earlier date can be NotCovered.
The dictionary is an editorial and derived layer; it does not alter or become part of the archived official text.
